title: QuantArk execution normalized economics payload
description: Flat dotted-path -> scalar-leaf mapping produced by quantark.execution.scenario.validate.normalized_cell_payload: the outcome's normalized_economics pairs plus the reserved 'value.native' leaf. Non-numeric native values normalize to canonical fingerprints or '<uncomparable:...>' strings, so every leaf — including value.native — is the full number/string/boolean/null union. Keys prefixed 'numerical.' are the plan-dependent tier. Versioned by the enclosing scenario/v1 protocol (the payload itself is a comparison artifact, not a wire envelope).
